title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
title_zh: 描绘不可见之物：GUI智能体中面向隐藏目标探索的交互感知

paragraphs.en: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu . By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu .

paragraphs.en: Although large language models (LLMs) have made surprising progress on command-line interface (CLI) tasks ( Yang et al., 2023b ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) remains challenging ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2026 ) . Beyond the well-known challenge of interpreting visual semantics, the limited content visible within a bounded viewport constitutes a key bottleneck for GUI agents. Specifically, to preserve visual appeal, UI designs constrain element density and thereby prevent visual clutter ( Reinecke et al., 2013 ) . Modern UIs therefore widely use scrollable containers, such as lists and carousels, to accommodate additional functionality and content beyond the current view, requiring scrolling to reveal them ( Pfeuffer and Li, 2018 ) . At every step, GUI agents are thus forced to decide under uncertainty whether to pick a visible target or explore hidden areas.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在命令行界面（CLI）任务上取得了惊人的进展（Yang et al., 2023b；Yang et al., 2024），但通过图形用户界面（GUI）可靠地执行任务仍然具有挑战性（Xie et al., 2024；Kong et al., 2026）。 除了广为人知的视觉语义解读难题之外，有限视口内可见内容受限这一问题是GUI智能体的一个关键瓶颈。 具体而言，为了保持视觉美感，UI设计会限制元素密度，从而避免视觉杂乱（Reinecke et al., 2013）。 因此，现代UI广泛使用可滚动容器，例如列表和轮播组件，以容纳当前视图之外的其他功能和内容，需要通过滚动才能将其显示出来（Pfeuffer and Li, 2018）。 于是在每一步，GUI智能体都被迫在不确定性下决策：是选择可见的目标，还是探索隐藏的区域。

paragraphs.en: This dilemma is particularly acute in mobile GUIs. Limited screen size leaves many UI elements outside the current viewport, accessible only through swipe interactions. Although most GUI agents already support swipe as an action primitive ( Rawles et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , recent research shows that reliably completing mobile tasks remains challenging ( Rawles et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2026 ) . To quantify this difficulty, this paper conducts a study of 7 GUI agents across 218 tasks and finds that the rate of correctly planned swipe actions is 47.3 percentage points lower than that of click actions. Further analysis of 83.73% failed tasks shows that a major cause of failure is clicking an incorrect visible target when the correct target is still hidden. These findings highlight the need to help agents recognize opportunities for hidden-area exploration rather than force a choice among visible elements.
paragraphs.zh: 这一困境在移动 GUI 中尤为突出。 有限的屏幕尺寸使得许多 UI 元素位于当前视口之外，只能通过滑动操作才能访问。 尽管大多数 GUI 智能体已经支持将滑动作为动作原语（Rawles et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2024; Lin et al., 2025; Qin et al., 2025），但最近的研究表明，可靠地完成移动任务仍然具有挑战性（Rawles et al., 2025; Kong et al., 2026）。 为了量化这一困难，本文对 7 个 GUI 智能体在 218 个任务上进行了研究，发现正确规划滑动动作的比率比点击动作低 47.3 个百分点。 对 83.73% 失败任务的进一步分析表明，失败的一个主要原因是：当正确目标仍然隐藏时，智能体点击了错误可见目标。 这些发现凸显了帮助智能体识别隐藏区域探索机会的必要性，而不是强迫其在可见元素中做出选择。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, this paper focuses on equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception, providing explicit cues about where hidden-area exploration is possible. Achieving this goal involves two challenges. First, scrollable regions lack clear visual indicators, requiring an understanding of UI structure and semantics to identify them. To address this challenge, this paper builds on the UI understanding capabilities of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and fine-tunes it on 540 manually collected and annotated UI screens, to develop Hagasu for scrollable region perception. Second, improving a specific capability of a generalist GUI agent may compromise its broader capabilities. This paper therefore implements Hagasu as a non-intrusive plug-in that modifies only the GUI screenshot and prompt presented to the agent: it marks predicted scrollable regions on the screenshot and adds textual cues for swipe exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本文聚焦于为 GUI 智能体配备可滚动区域感知能力，为智能体提供关于何处可以进行隐藏区域探索的明确线索。 实现这一目标涉及两大挑战。 首先，可滚动区域缺乏清晰的视觉指示，需要理解 UI 的结构与语义才能识别它们。 为应对这一挑战，本文基于预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的 UI 理解能力，在 540 张人工收集并标注的 UI 屏幕上对其进行微调，从而开发出用于可滚动区域感知的 Hagasu。 其次，提升通用型 GUI 智能体的某项特定能力可能会损害其更广泛的能力。 因此，本文将 Hagasu 实现为一个非侵入式插件，它只修改呈现给智能体的 GUI 截图和提示词：在截图上标记预测出的可滚动区域，并添加用于滑动探索的文本线索。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments evaluate Hagasu in scrollable-region perception, swipe planning, and end-to-end task completion. Comparisons and ablations across eight configurations demonstrate the effectiveness of Hagasu ’s training design for scrollable-region perception, with the full configuration achieving the highest recall of 78.46%. In offline swipe-planning experiments with nine VLMs, Hagasu raises mean swipe prediction recall from 46.02% to 53.87%. And it decreases click prediction recall by only 1.67 percentage points. Finally, online experiments show that integrating Hagasu into existing GUI agents increases mean end-to-end task success rate from 64.81% to 82.72%. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the scrollable-region dataset and the source code of Hagasu .
paragraphs.zh: 大量实验评估了 Hagasu 在可滚动区域感知、滑动规划和端到端任务完成方面的表现。 跨八种配置的对比与消融实验证明了 Hagasu 的训练设计在可滚动区域感知上的有效性，完整配置取得了最高的 78.46% 召回率。 在涉及九个 VLM 的离线滑动规划实验中，Hagasu 将滑动预测的平均召回率从 46.02% 提升至 53.87%。 同时仅使点击预测的召回率下降 1.67 个百分点。 最后，在线实验表明，将 Hagasu 集成到现有 GUI 智能体中可将端到端任务的平均成功率从 64.81% 提升至 82.72%。 为促进后续研究，我们发布了可滚动区域数据集以及 Hagasu 的源代码。

paragraphs.en: We summarize the contributions of this paper as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将本文的贡献总结如下。

paragraphs.en: We systematically identify off-screen content as a critical, understudied bottleneck that partially explains the performance gap between GUI and CLI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们系统地将屏幕外内容识别为一个关键且研究不足的瓶颈，它在一定程度上解释了 GUI 智能体与 CLI 智能体之间的性能差距。

paragraphs.en: We build the first dataset of scrollable UI regions and open-source Hagasu , a multimodal model that equips GUI agents with scrollable-region perception for proactive hidden-area exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了首个可滚动UI区域数据集，并开源了Hagasu——一个多模态模型，它为GUI智能体提供可滚动区域感知能力，以实现主动的隐藏区域探索。

paragraphs.en: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of scrollable-region perception in improving GUI agents’ task completion on explore-dependent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 全面的实验证明了可滚动区域感知在提升 GUI 智能体完成依赖探索类任务方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: This section explains the decision pattern underlying ordinary click interactions and why hidden targets require a different course of action. We first describe greedy interaction as selecting a task-relevant component from the current viewport. We then explain why agents need swipe-based exploration when the correct target is hidden outside that viewport. Finally, we present a preliminary study comparing click and swipe planning across different interaction scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 本节解释普通点击交互背后的决策模式，以及为什么隐藏目标需要不同的操作方式。 我们首先将贪婪交互描述为从当前视口中选择与任务相关的组件。 然后我们解释为什么当正确目标隐藏在该视口之外时，智能体需要基于滑动的探索。 最后，我们呈现一项初步研究，比较不同交互场景下的点击与滑动规划。

sents.en: We first describe greedy interaction as selecting a task-relevant component from the current viewport.
sents.zh: 我们首先将贪婪交互描述为从当前视口中选择与任务相关的组件。

sents.en: We then explain why agents need swipe-based exploration when the correct target is hidden outside that viewport.
sents.zh: 然后我们解释为什么当正确目标隐藏在该视口之外时，智能体需要基于滑动的探索。

sents.en: Finally, we present a preliminary study comparing click and swipe planning across different interaction scenarios.
sents.zh: 最后，我们呈现一项初步研究，比较不同交互场景下的点击与滑动规划。

paragraphs.en: GUI agents commonly follow an observation, decision, and execution loop, selecting actions based on the current interface, task instruction, and interaction history ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) . For a click action, this decision involves selecting an element in the current viewport and clicking it. We describe this pattern as greedy interaction : choosing the visible element that appears most likely to advance the task. Here, greedy characterizes the choice among currently visible candidates, even when guided by an explicit plan or interaction history.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 智能体通常遵循观察、决策与执行的循环，根据当前界面、任务指令和交互历史来选择动作（Yao et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2024; Rawles et al., 2025）。 对于点击动作而言，这一决策涉及在当前视口中选择一个元素并点击它。 我们将这种模式称为贪婪交互：选择当前可见的、看起来最有可能推进任务的元素。 这里的“贪婪”刻画的是在当前可见候选之间的选择，即使智能体受到明确计划或交互历史的引导也是如此。

paragraphs.en: This strategy works when the current viewport contains the correct target, reducing click planning to semantic matching and coordinate grounding. For example, an agent can fulfill a request to open Settings by identifying and clicking the visible Settings button. Existing GUI grounding methods support this process by mapping task descriptions to visible UI elements and their locations ( Shaw et al., 2023 ; Baechler et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; You et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该策略适用于当前视口中已包含正确目标的情况，从而将点击规划简化为语义匹配与坐标定位。 例如，智能体可以通过识别并点击可见的“设置”按钮来完成打开设置的请求。 现有的 GUI 定位方法通过将任务描述映射到可见的 UI 元素及其位置来支持这一过程（Shaw et al., 2023；Baechler et al., 2024；Cheng et al., 2024；You et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025b）。

An agent that continues to select among visible candidates may therefore force a wrong click instead of reaching the required target, as shown in Figure 1 . The decision must then extend beyond which element to click to whether exploration is needed to reveal the hidden target.

paragraphs.en: As mobile apps offer more functionality, their increasingly dense interfaces often contain more content than the screen can display at once. Task-relevant targets may be partially clipped or completely hidden within full-page or local scrollable regions, such as lists and carousels ( Rawles et al., 2023 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . When the target lies beyond the visible content, the agent must swipe to reveal it and then reassess the available interaction targets.

Planning this exploration requires the agent to decide when, where, and how to swipe before the target becomes visible. For example, finding a category hidden in a horizontal carousel requires swiping that carousel rather than clicking another visible category. The agent must infer the region’s function and relevance to the task, locate its boundaries, and choose a suitable swipe direction and extent. Multiple or nested scrollable regions complicate this decision, as swiping the wrong region may reveal content unrelated to the task.

Existing GUI agents already support swipe as an action primitive ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) . However, this support alone does not ensure that an agent can recognize when exploration is necessary or select the appropriate region to explore. This distinction motivates a quantitative comparison between click planning with visible targets and swipe planning for hidden-area exploration.

To examine the difficulty of hidden-area exploration compared with visible-target selection, we conduct a preliminary interaction study. The study compares click and swipe planning by prompting GUI agents to locate a specific UI element, either visible or hidden, and assessing whether they select the correct next interaction based on the current screenshot.

Both general-purpose VLM GUI agents and specialized GUI models are selected for this study. Specifically, general-purpose VLM GUI agents include Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and GPT-5.4 ( , 2026 ) . As for the specialized GUI models, we include GUI-Owl ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , UI-TARS ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , GUI-G 2 ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , UI-Venus 1.5 ( Team et al., 2026 ) and MAI-UI ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . To control for differences in input, all agents receive the same current screenshot and target element description.

Using an Android phone connected through ADB, we manually collected 218 UI interactions from 55 applications, including 36 Chinese-language and 19 English-language applications. These interactions include 192 swipe cases requiring exploration to reveal or reach the target component and 26 click cases with visible targets as the reference condition.
paragraphs.zh: 通过一台通过 ADB 连接的 Android 手机，我们从 55 个应用中手动收集了 218 次用户界面交互，其中包括 36 个中文应用和 19 个英文应用。 这些交互包括 192 个需要探索才能显示或到达目标组件的滑动用例，以及 26 个目标可见、作为参照条件的点击用例。

paragraphs.en: Since scrollable regions vary in appearance, we categorize these swipe interactions by direction (vertical or horizontal), scope (full-screen or local), and target visibility (partially visible or completely invisible). Specifically, full-screen scrolling refers to scrollable regions occupying more than 75% of the screen, while all remaining cases are classified as local swiping. As for visibility, we classify a target as completely invisible when less than 25% of its area is visible, and as partially visible when 25% to 75% is visible. The upper bound reflects the likelihood that targets with more than 75% of their area visible can already be interacted with directly.
paragraphs.zh: 由于可滚动区域的外观各不相同，我们按照方向（垂直或水平）、范围（全屏或局部）以及目标可见性（部分可见或完全不可见）对这些滑动交互进行分类。 具体而言，全屏滚动指的是可滚动区域占据屏幕面积超过 75% 的情况，而其余所有情况均被归类为局部滑动。 至于可见性，当目标的可见面积不足 25% 时，我们将其归类为完全不可见；当可见面积为 25% 至 75% 时，则归类为部分可见。 设定这一上限的原因在于，可见面积超过 75% 的目标很可能已经可以直接进行交互。

We then report the proportion of correctly planned interactions in each task category to compare click and swipe planning.

paragraphs.en: These results indicate that merely including swipe in an agent’s action space is far from sufficient for reliable GUI interaction. These findings motivate our subsequent investigation into prompting agents with scrollable-region information to encourage exploration and reduce incorrect clicks.

paragraphs.en: This section presents Hagasu , a scrollable-region perception module that supports hidden-area exploration through non-intrusive augmentation of GUI agents’ screenshots and prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍 Hagasu，这是一个可滚动区域感知模块，通过对智能体的截图和提示词进行非侵入式增强，支持隐藏区域的探索。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , the Hagasu workflow consists of dataset construction, model fine-tuning, and agent integration. First, we collect Android screenshots and accessibility XML through ADB and manually verify and refine XML-derived region candidates to construct screenshot–region pairs. Second, we build on Qwen3.5-9B’s UI understanding capabilities through two-stage LoRA fine-tuning, enabling it to predict all scrollable regions as a JSON list of bounding boxes. Third, when integrated into a GUI agent, Hagasu marks its predicted regions on the screenshot at each step and supplements the agent’s prompt with cues for swipe-based exploration. The base agent combines these cues with the task and interaction history to plan its next action, retaining control over whether and how to click or swipe.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，Hagasu 的工作流程包括数据集构建、模型微调和智能体集成。 首先，我们通过 ADB 采集 Android 截图和无障碍 XML，并人工校验和优化由 XML 得到的区域候选，以构建“截图—区域”配对数据。 其次，我们基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 UI 理解能力进行两阶段 LoRA 微调，使其能够以边界框 JSON 列表的形式预测所有可滚动区域。 第三，当集成到 GUI 智能体中时，Hagasu 在每一步将预测的区域标注在截图上，并在智能体的提示中加入基于滑动的探索线索。 基础智能体将这些线索与任务和交互历史相结合来规划下一步动作，并保留对是否以及如何点击或滑动的控制权。

paragraphs.en: 49 apps are selected from Google Play’s popular app rankings ( , 2026 ) , including 33 Chinese- and 16 English-language apps. paragraphs.en: Scrollable regions lack clear visual indicators, making it difficult for models to recognize them and associate their visual appearance with swipe interaction semantics. Given the limited size of our manually collected dataset, we adopt LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) to adapt the model through a small number of trainable parameters instead of full-parameter fine-tuning. To address this challenge while making effective use of the limited data, we organize LoRA fine-tuning into two stages. The first stage strengthens visual perception of UI images, focusing on the appearance and spatial structure of UI regions. The second stage fine-tunes the language model to connect swipe interaction semantics with the visual features learned in the first stage.

paragraphs.en: Following prior work on Qwen-based GUI models ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , we select Qwen3.5-9B as the backbone of Hagasu . Specifically, the first stage trains LoRA adapters in the visual component while keeping the original visual weights, the merger, and the language model frozen. The trained visual adapters are then merged into the backbone to initialize the second stage. In the second stage, we train newly introduced language LoRA adapters and all merger parameters while keeping the adapted visual component and the original language-model weights frozen. Both stages use LoRA with rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout 0.1, with supervision provided by screenshots paired with JSON annotations and training samples drawn using the multi-region oversampling strategy described above.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用以往基于 Qwen 的图形界面模型的研究（Cheng et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025），我们选择 Qwen3.5-9B 作为 Hagasu 的骨干模型。 具体而言，第一阶段在视觉组件中训练 LoRA 适配器，同时保持原始视觉权重、合并器（merger）和语言模型冻结。 训练好的视觉适配器随后被合并进骨干模型，用于初始化第二阶段。 在第二阶段，我们训练新引入的语言 LoRA 适配器以及所有合并器参数，同时保持经过适配的视觉组件和原始语言模型权重冻结。 两个阶段均使用秩为 16、α = 32 \alpha=32、dropout 为 0.1 的 LoRA，监督信号由配对 JSON 标注的截图提供，训练样本则按照上述多区域过采样策略抽取。

paragraphs.en: When integrated into GUI agents, Hagasu is called for every screenshot. Although Hagasu modifies the screenshot and prompt, these modifications serve only as supplementary information about where swipe exploration is possible. They neither force the agent to make any particular decision nor override its action policy. Therefore, these agents retain full control over whether and how to click, swipe, or perform other supported actions based on the task discription and the current interaction state.
paragraphs.zh: 当集成到 GUI 智能体中时，Hagasu 会在每次截图时被调用。 尽管 Hagasu 会修改截图和提示词，但这些修改仅作为关于可以在何处进行滑动探索的补充信息。 它们既不强制智能体做出任何特定决策，也不覆盖其动作策略。 因此，这些智能体仍完全掌控是否以及如何根据任务描述和当前交互状态执行点击、滑动或其他支持的操作。

paragraphs.en: Although this paper simplifies most GUI-agent components, such as reflection, to highlight the effect of Hagasu on planning, memory remains essential for multi-step interaction tasks. We therefore provide a simplified memory management module to support subsequent evaluation. Specifically, two memory management strategies are designed for offline and online experiments. In offline experiments, the history briefly describes the screenshots and actions from preceding steps. Since the preceding steps are deterministic, we prepared a predetermined interaction history for each step. At each step, the model receives the interaction history of all preceding steps in that task. In online experiments, the agents will generate their own interaction history after each step while performing the task. In addition to screenshot and action descriptions in the same format as in offline experiments, the agent also retains the previous screenshot and compares it with the current one to determine whether the action changed the page, helping reduce the risk of entering an infinite loop.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管本文为了突出 Hagasu 对规划的作用而简化了大多数 GUI 智能体组件（例如反思），但记忆在多步交互任务中仍然至关重要。 因此，我们提供了一个简化的记忆管理模块以支持后续评估。 具体而言，我们为离线实验和在线实验分别设计了两种记忆管理策略。 在离线实验中，历史记录简要描述前序步骤的截图和动作。 由于前序步骤是确定性的，我们为每一步准备了预先确定的交互历史。 在每一步，模型会接收该任务中所有前序步骤的交互历史。 在在线实验中，智能体会在执行任务时于每一步之后自行生成交互历史。 除了与离线实验相同格式的截图和动作描述之外，智能体还会保留上一步的截图，并将其与当前截图进行比较，以判断该动作是否改变了页面，这有助于降低陷入无限循环的风险。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we evaluate whether Hagasu can correctly identify all scrollable regions in a UI screenshot and accurately localize their boundaries. We use the dataset described in Section 3 , containing 67 mobile UI screenshots. Each screenshot is annotated with all scrollable regions and their boundaries. Note that a screenshot may contain multiple scrollable regions. Therefore, we compare the predicted region set with the complete ground-truth set.

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , we construct an offline benchmark from human-recorded successful trajectories of 60 mobile GUI interaction tasks, with each trajectory containing an average of 4.1 actions and at least one swipe. Specifically, this benchmark contains 245 interaction steps, including 99 swipes (39 vertical and 60 horizontal) and 146 clicks. It evaluates whether agents can correctly decide between acting on visible content and exploring off-screen content when prompted with Hagasu ’s scrollable-region predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ2，我们基于人工录制的 60 个移动端 GUI 交互任务的成功轨迹构建了一个离线基准，每条轨迹平均包含 4.1 个动作，且至少包含一次滑动。 具体而言，该基准包含 245 个交互步骤，其中包括 99 次滑动（39 次垂直滑动和 60 次水平滑动）和 146 次点击。 它评估了当向智能体提供 Hagasu 的可滚动区域预测时，智能体能否在操作屏幕可见内容与探索屏幕外内容之间正确做出决策。

The tasks cover content discovery, media playback, product search, and travel-related information retrieval.

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we compare Hagasu with both untuned base models and several training variants to understand where the improvement in scrollable-region perception comes from. Specifically, we first evaluate two untuned baselines, Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3.5-9B ( , 2026 ) . We also include Qwen3.5-9B + XML , where scrollable-region candidates extracted from XML are provided to the model for visual refinement. This comparison examines whether explicit structural cues can compensate for the lack of task-specific fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ1，我们将 Hagasu 与未调优的基础模型以及若干训练变体进行对比，以了解可滚动区域感知能力的提升来自何处。 具体而言，我们首先评估两个未调优的基线模型：Qwen3-VL-8B（ Bai et al., 2025 ）和 Qwen3.5-9B（ , 2026 ）。 我们还加入了 Qwen3.5-9B + XML，即将从 XML 中提取的可滚动区域候选提供给模型进行视觉精修。 该对比旨在检验显式的结构线索能否弥补缺乏任务特定微调的不足。

sents.en: We also include Qwen3.5-9B + XML , where scrollable-region candidates extracted from XML are provided to the model for visual refinement.
sents.zh: 我们还加入了 Qwen3.5-9B + XML，即将从 XML 中提取的可滚动区域候选提供给模型进行视觉精修。

sents.en: This comparison examines whether explicit structural cues can compensate for the lack of task-specific fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 该对比旨在检验显式的结构线索能否弥补缺乏任务特定微调的不足。

paragraphs.en: We then construct several variants of Hagasu to study its training design. Qwen3.5-9B + one-stage SFT directly fine-tunes the merger and language-model layers while keeping the visual encoder frozen. Qwen3.5-9B + two-stage SFT further introduces the visual fine-tuning stage described in Section 3 . Besides, to examine the effect of the base model, we apply the same two-stage SFT procedure to Qwen3-VL-8B, yielding Qwen3-VL-8B + two-stage SFT . Our full Hagasu configuration further applies multi-region oversampling on top of Qwen3.5-9B with two-stage SFT. Finally, we append a GRPO stage to the full configuration to examine whether reinforcement learning provides additional gains. The relationship among these configurations is summarized in Figure 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 随后我们构建了 Hagasu 的多个变体来研究其训练设计。 Qwen3.5-9B + 单阶段 SFT 直接对合并层与语言模型层进行微调，同时保持视觉编码器冻结。 Qwen3.5-9B + 两阶段 SFT 进一步引入了第 3 节中描述的视觉微调阶段。 此外，为考察基础模型的影响，我们将相同的两阶段 SFT 流程应用于 Qwen3-VL-8B，得到 Qwen3-VL-8B + 两阶段 SFT。 我们的完整 Hagasu 配置在采用两阶段 SFT 的 Qwen3.5-9B 之上进一步应用了多区域过采样。 最后，我们在完整配置上追加一个 GRPO 阶段，以检验强化学习是否能带来额外收益。 这些配置之间的关系总结于图 5。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , we evaluate nine VLMs with different model scales and GUI capabilities: GPT-6-Luna ( , 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-Luna ( , 2026 ) , Seed-2.1-Pro ( , 2026 ) , Seed-Evolving ( , 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( , 2026 ) , Qwen3.7-Plus ( , 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-9B ( , 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision ( , 2026 ) , and GUI-OWL-7B ( Ye et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we evaluate two aspects of scrollable-region perception: whether Hagasu identifies the correct set of regions and how accurately it localizes their boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ1，我们评估了可滚动区域感知的两个方面：Hagasu 是否能识别出正确的区域集合，以及它对这些区域边界的定位准确度如何。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate region detection capability , we report Precision, Recall, F1, and Exact Match. Predicted and ground-truth regions are matched one-to-one within each screenshot using the Hungarian algorithm ( Kuhn, 1955 ) , with IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 as the matching threshold. Matched predictions are counted as true positives, while unmatched predictions and ground-truth regions are counted as false positives and false negatives, respectively. Precision, Recall, and F1 are micro-averaged over the entire test set. Exact Match measures the percentage of screenshots for which the complete set of scrollable regions is correctly detected, with neither missing nor extra regions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估区域检测能力，我们报告精确率、召回率、F1 和完全匹配率。 预测区域与真实区域在每个截图内使用匈牙利算法（Kuhn, 1955）进行一对一匹配，匹配阈值为 IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5。 匹配上的预测记为真正例，而未匹配的预测和真实区域分别记为假正例和假负例。 精确率、召回率和 F1 在整个测试集上进行微平均。 完全匹配率衡量的是可滚动区域完整集合被正确检测、既无遗漏也无多余的截图所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: As for localization accuracy , we report set-level mIoU. For each screenshot, we perform one-to-one matching between predicted and ground-truth regions to maximize their total IoU. The summed IoU is normalized by the larger number of predicted or ground-truth regions, such that both missing and extra regions are penalized. We then average the resulting scores across all screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 在定位精度方面，我们报告集合级别的 mIoU。 对于每张截图，我们在预测区域与真实区域之间执行一对一匹配，以最大化二者的总 IoU。 求和后的 IoU 会除以预测区域数与真实区域数中较大者进行归一化，从而同时惩罚缺失区域和多余区域。 然后我们在所有截图上对得到的分数取平均。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , we report three metrics to evaluate both the benefit and potential side effects of scrollable-region cues. Swipe Prediction Recall is the percentage of the 99 reference swipe steps correctly predicted as swipes, measuring the agent’s ability to identify when exploration is needed. Click Prediction Recall is the percentage of the 146 reference click steps correctly predicted as clicks, measuring whether region cues preserve normal click decisions. Finally, Click → \rightarrow Swipe Rate is the percentage of reference click steps incorrectly predicted as swipes, specifically measuring whether the cues cause agents to over-select swipe actions.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ2，我们报告三项指标，以评估可滚动区域提示的收益与潜在副作用。 滑动预测召回率（Swipe Prediction Recall）是指在 99 个参考滑动步骤中被正确预测为滑动的百分比，衡量智能体识别何时需要探索的能力。 点击预测召回率（Click Prediction Recall）是指在 146 个参考点击步骤中被正确预测为点击的百分比，衡量区域提示是否保留了正常的点击决策。 最后，点击误判为滑动率（Click \rightarrow Swipe Rate）是指参考点击步骤被错误预测为滑动的百分比，专门衡量这些提示是否会导致智能体过度选择滑动操作。

paragraphs.en: We collect mobile UI screens from Android devices through ADB ( , 2026 ) , recording both the screenshot and its accessibility XML for each UI state. During annotation, XML- and image-based proposals are used only as candidate regions to reduce manual effort. Two annotators independently verify these candidates, remove invalid regions, and add missed regions, while disagreements are resolved by a third annotator. The final annotation contains the complete set of manually verified scrollable-region bounding boxes for each screenshot.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 ADB ( , 2026 ) 从 Android 设备收集移动端 UI 界面，记录每个 UI 状态的截图及其无障碍 XML。 在标注过程中，基于 XML 和图像的候选仅作为候选区域使用，以减少人工工作量。 两名标注员独立验证这些候选区域，删除无效区域并补充遗漏的区域，分歧由第三名标注员裁决解决。 最终标注包含每张截图经人工验证的可滚动区域边界框的完整集合。

paragraphs.en: In the plug-in setting, an annotation service retrieves or predicts region boxes for each decision screenshot, renders them on the image, and adds a textual cue that the marked regions are scrollable. The base agent then combines this augmented observation with the task and interaction history to decide whether and how to click or swipe, while retaining control of action execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在插件模式下，标注服务会为每张决策截图检索或预测区域框，将其渲染到图像上，并添加文字提示说明被标记的区域是可滚动的。 基础智能体随后将该增强观察与任务和交互历史相结合，以决定是否以及如何点击或滑动，同时保留动作执行的控制权。

paragraphs.en: For RQ3 , tasks are executed on a Xiaomi 13 smartphone running Android 16 with a screen resolution of 2400 × 1080 2400\times 1080 pixels. The initial state is manually restored before each run. For a given task, the instruction and action budget remain fixed across agents, settings, and repetitions. To reduce repeated annotation, Hagasu employs a persistent cache of unannotated screenshots and their predicted region boxes. When the current screenshot matches a cached image of the same dimensions with a structural similarity index (SSIM) of at least 0.90, the boxes from the most similar image are rendered on the current screenshot. paragraphs.en: RQ3 evaluates how Hagasu affects the end-to-end task automation performance of GUI agents. This experiment examines whether scrollable-region perception can lead to higher end-to-end task success and assesses the additional execution cost. The three VLMs with the highest swipe prediction recall in RQ2 ’s + Hagasu setting are selected for end-to-end evaluation. GUI agents powered by these VLMs are then evaluated under Vanilla and + Hagasu on the 18 swipe-dependent tasks, with each task run three times per agent and setting and success assessed manually for each run. Table 4 reports task success rate (SR) and its standard deviation across rounds ( σ \sigma (SR)), average interaction steps for all runs and for successful runs, and per-run averages of execution time and input/output token usage.

paragraphs.en: Given GUI agents’ ability to recover from suboptimal actions during task execution, we evaluate whether the proactive exploration encouraged by Hagasu reduces the number of interactions required to complete a task. Overall, + Hagasu reduces the mean number of interactions per task, with the effect varying across agents: Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.7-Plus complete more tasks with fewer interactions, whereas GPT-6-Luna follows longer trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于智能体在任务执行过程中从次优动作中恢复的能力，我们评估 Hagasu 所鼓励的主动探索是否减少了完成任务所需的交互次数。 总体而言，+ Hagasu 降低了每个任务的平均交互次数，且效果因智能体而异：Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.7-Plus 能以更少的交互完成更多任务，而 GPT-6-Luna 则遵循更长的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Adding Hagasu naturally introduces additional execution overhead, increasing active execution time by 49.46 seconds per run on average, with increases ranging from 33.40 to 71.07 seconds across agents. This overhead increases the time required to obtain a task outcome and may reduce the number of attempts possible under a fixed time budget. These measurements already account for cache reuse, with hit rates ranging from 62.30% to 70.34% among calls carrying cache metadata.

paragraphs.en: This section first uses a case study to show that, although scrollable-region perception has proven valuable for GUI agents, integrating it through supplementary cues has inevitable limitations. The case illustrates how Hagasu can degrade an agent’s task performance. It then considers threats to validity arising from manual annotation and variations in agent performance.

paragraphs.en: In RQ3, we observe that although Hagasu is designed to preserve agents’ decision-making autonomy, its predictions can still misguide their exploration. paragraphs.en: This case indicates that preserving an agent’s decision-making autonomy does not fully prevent incomplete perception from misleading its planning. Although Hagasu only provides supplementary guidance without enforcing any action, the agent may still rely too heavily on these cues and fail to revise its search strategy after repeated unsuccessful interactions. This suggests future research on internalizing scrollable-region perception into GUI agents through large-scale joint training with task planning, so that agents can systematically learn when to explore, where to explore, and when to stop exploring.
paragraphs.zh: 该案例表明，保留智能体的决策自主性并不能完全防止不完整的感知误导其规划。 尽管 Hagasu 只提供辅助性引导而不强制执行任何操作，智能体仍可能过度依赖这些提示，并在多次 unsuccessful 交互后未能修正其搜索策略。 这提示未来的研究可通过与任务规划的大规模联合训练，将可滚动区域的感知内化到 GUI 智能体中，使智能体能够系统地学习何时探索、在哪里探索以及何时停止探索。

paragraphs.en: Since scrollable regions may lack clear visual boundaries, manual annotations are susceptible to omissions and errors. Local or nested regions can be overlooked, and annotators may disagree on their boundaries, affecting both training supervision and the reference annotations used in RQ1. Although XML-derived candidates provide an initial set of regions for inspection, the candidate set may omit scrollable regions or include non-scrollable ones. To mitigate this threat, two authors independently inspect each screenshot, remove invalid candidates, and add missed regions. A third author resolves disagreements to finalize the annotations. Although some annotation noise may remain, candidate-assisted inspection helps identify potential regions, while independent checks and disagreement resolution reduce reliance on individual judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 由于可滚动区域可能缺乏清晰的视觉边界，人工标注容易出现遗漏和错误。 局部或嵌套区域可能被忽视，标注者对区域边界的意见也可能不一致，这会影响训练监督以及 RQ1 中使用的参考标注。 尽管基于 XML 生成的候选提供了一组可供检查的初始区域，但候选集合可能遗漏可滚动区域或包含不可滚动的区域。 为缓解这一威胁，两位作者独立检查每张截图，移除无效候选，并补充遗漏的区域。 第三位作者解决分歧，以最终确定标注。 尽管可能仍存在一些标注噪声，但借助候选的检查有助于识别潜在区域，而独立核查与分歧解决则降低了对个人判断的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Changes in UI states and variations in agent behavior may affect the observed performance gains from Hagasu . The same task may encounter different interface states or action sequences across executions, so a single run may overestimate or underestimate the benefit of the plug-in. We acknowledge this threat and seek to mitigate it by evaluating diverse test tasks with multiple agents. This broader evaluation reduces dependence on a particular task or agent’s decision patterns. In RQ3, Hagasu improves the task success rate of all three evaluated agents. Moreover, each task in RQ3 is executed three times, and we report the mean within-agent population standard deviation of round-level task success rates (5.33 percentage points under + Hagasu , obtained by averaging the three agents’ unrounded standard deviations over the three evaluation rounds; Table 4 ). These repeated runs allow us to assess whether the observed gains persist across executions and quantify the remaining variation.
paragraphs.zh: UI 状态的变化和智能体行为的差异可能会影响从 Hagasu 观察到的性能提升。 同一任务在不同执行中可能遇到不同的界面状态或动作序列，因此单次运行可能高估或低估该插件带来的收益。 我们承认这一威胁，并尝试通过使用多个智能体评估多样化的测试任务来缓解它。 这种更广泛的评估降低了对特定任务或某个智能体决策模式的依赖。 在 RQ3 中，Hagasu 提升了所评估的三个智能体的任务成功率。 此外，RQ3 中的每个任务都执行了三次，我们报告了轮次级任务成功率的智能体内总体标准差的均值（在 + Hagasu 条件下为 5.33 个百分点，通过对三个智能体在三轮评估中未取整的标准差取平均得到；见表 4）。 这些重复运行使我们能够评估观察到的收益是否在不同执行中持续存在，并量化剩余的变异。

paragraphs.en: Identifying and localizing interactive regions is fundamental to GUI task automation. Structured approaches use UI hierarchies and element attributes to expose interaction targets ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ) , while visual approaches ground actions directly in screenshots. ScreenAI ( Baechler et al., 2024 ) studies screen understanding and UI element annotation, and SeeClick ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) develops GUI grounding through visual pretraining. Building on visual localization, ShowUI ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , OS-Atlas ( Wu et al., 2025c ) , and UIPro ( Li et al., 2025a ) further connect grounding with GUI action prediction. ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025b ) evaluates these localization capabilities in high-resolution professional interfaces.

paragraphs.en: Beyond locating interaction targets, existing work also investigates what interactions UI regions support. Schoop et al. ( Schoop et al., 2022 ) predict whether users perceive UI elements as tappable, while Ferret-UI ( You et al., 2024 ) supports UI function inference and goal-oriented interaction conversations. OmniParser ( Lu et al., 2024 ) combines interactable-element detection with functional descriptions to support action grounding. Complementing such perception methods, Set-of-Mark prompting ( Yang et al., 2023a ) overlays marks on image regions so that a multimodal model can refer to them explicitly. These methods improve the localization, functional understanding, and explicit referencing of visible interaction targets. However, none specifically focuses on identifying scrollable containers that can reveal content beyond the current viewport.
paragraphs.zh: 除定位交互目标外，现有工作还研究 UI 区域支持哪些交互。Schoop 等人 （Schoop et al., 2022）预测用户是否将 UI 元素感知为可点击，而 Ferret-UI（You et al., 2024）支持 UI 功能推断和面向目标的交互对话。 OmniParser（Lu et al., 2024）将可交互元素检测与功能描述相结合，以支持动作定位。 作为对此类感知方法的补充，Set-of-Mark 提示（Yang et al., 2023a）在图像区域上叠加标记，使多模态模型能够显式地引用它们。 这些方法提升了对可见交互目标的定位、功能理解和显式引用能力。 然而，没有一项工作专门聚焦于识别能够展示当前视口之外内容的可滚动容器。

paragraphs.en: Existing work guides GUI exploration to improve testing efficiency. Stoat ( Su et al., 2017 ) uses heuristic exploration strategies and GUI models to guide test generation. LLMDroid ( Wang et al., 2025 ) uses general-purpose LLMs to direct existing testing tools toward additional functionality when coverage growth slows. Guardian ( Ran et al., 2024 ) uses runtime action constraints and replanning to guide exploration toward UI states relevant to testing objectives. These approaches focus on selecting and adjusting exploration actions to improve testing efficiency, rather than explicitly learning the interaction semantics that determine which UI regions support scrolling.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作通过引导 GUI 探索来提升测试效率。 Stoat（Su et al., 2017）使用启发式探索策略和 GUI 模型来指导测试生成。 LLMDroid（Wang et al., 2025）使用通用大语言模型，在覆盖率增长放缓时将现有测试工具引向更多功能。 Guardian（Ran et al., 2024）使用运行时动作约束和重规划，将探索引导至与测试目标相关的 UI 状态。 这些方法侧重于选择和调整探索动作以提升测试效率，而不是显式学习决定哪些 UI 区域支持滚动的交互语义。

paragraphs.en: Recent GUI agents also improve planning through interaction history, reflection, and proactive exploration ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . In particular, MobileUse ( Li et al., 2026 ) combines hierarchical reflection with self-planned exploration to build knowledge of unfamiliar environments. These mechanisms address how agents accumulate and use experience to guide subsequent actions. However, for complex apps, building such knowledge can require extensive preliminary exploration without guaranteeing useful guidance for a given task. Hagasu instead provides scrollable-region cues directly from the current screenshot and is shown to be effective with modest overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的GUI智能体还通过交互历史、反思和主动探索来改进规划（Liu et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2025a；Li et al., 2026）。 特别是，MobileUse（Li et al., 2026）将分层反思与自规划的探索相结合，以构建对陌生环境的认知。 这些机制解决的是智能体如何积累并利用经验来指导后续行动的问题。 然而，对于复杂应用，构建此类认知可能需要大量的预先探索，且无法保证对给定任务提供有用的指导。 Hagasu 则直接从当前截图中提供可滚动区域的线索，并被证明能以适度的开销取得良好效果。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the huge gap between agents’ GUI and CLI task performance, this paper identifies invisible content as a key bottleneck for GUI tasks. When the correct target is hidden, agents often click an incorrect visible target instead of exploring. Built on a manually annotated dataset, Hagasu provides non-intrusive scrollable-region cues that support hidden-area exploration while preserving GUI agents’ decision-making autonomy. Experiments demonstrate that such scrollable-region prompts improve swipe selection accuracy by 17.1% and result in a 27.6% increase in the end-to-end task completion rate. These findings suggest that making exploration opportunities explicit is a practical direction for improving GUI agent harnesses under partial observability.
paragraphs.zh: 受智能体在 GUI 任务与 CLI 任务性能之间巨大差距的启发，本文识别出不可见内容是 GUI 任务的一个关键瓶颈。 当正确目标被隐藏时，智能体往往会点击一个错误但可见的目标，而不是进行探索。 基于一个人工标注的数据集，Hagasu 提供非侵入式的可滚动区域提示，在支持隐藏区域探索的同时保留 GUI 智能体的决策自主性。 实验表明，这类可滚动区域提示将滑动选择准确率提升了 17.1%，并使端到端任务完成率提高了 27.6%。 这些发现表明，将探索机会显式化是在部分可观测条件下改进 GUI 智能体运行框架的一个实用方向。
